items.html: And behold, also the three highest of AA of Beriah, which are HGT as stated above, also pass through the screen, and do not cleave the screen, but they are a diminishing light, part of which passes through the screen. But that point of the Malchut of Atzilut mentioned above, which descended to be clothed in these three highest of AA, is the very light of the Malchut of Atzilut. Therefore it breaks and cleaves the screen itself, and descends and is clothed in the three highest of AA.
